text.en:
Section twelve of Presidential Decree No. 941 is hereby amended to read as follows:
"SEC. 12. Appropriation. - To meet the organizational and other expenses of the Export Council, the amount
of Five Million (P5 M) Pesos, or so much thereof as may be necessary for the fiscal year ending December 31,
1976, is hereby appropriated out of any funds in the National Treasury not otherwise appropriated. Thereafter,
the same amount, which may be adjusted by an amount reflective of the change in total export performance
during the year immediately preceding the budget year, or such sum as may be necessary for the purpose shall
be included in the annual General Appropriations Decree."

This Decree shall take effect immediately.
Done in the City of Manila, this 22nd day of September in the year of Our Lord, nineteen hundred and
seventy-six.
